notes.title: New Languages, New Patch and New Date for Chapter 2
notes.notes:
Hi dear players !

First of all, we'd like to thank you for your continuous presence and help. Your feedback on discord and Steam forums helped us to make this version of looK INside a definitive one (or so we hope!) 

[h1]That being said, here is the patch note:[/h1]

[NEW] We added THREE more texts languages to looK INside. It is now available in German, Japanese and Dutch. We hope this localization is everything you wanted. 

[NEW] English dubbing is now done by a native speaker. As much as we love MisterMV, we felt like we needed an English-speaking actor to convey the game as we wished. 

[QOL] We noticed you were troubled by the empty portrait slot so we added a portrait that can be unlock on the scrapbook page. 

[h1]Some bugfixes:[/h1]


[*] [TREE] The tree does not lock at the loading of the game if all portraits are well-placed but incomplete. 
[*] [BEDROOM] Items put in the bag do not reappear after loading. 
[*] [SCRAPBOOK] portraits now unlock as they should when doing all the coffeeshop scenes on different game sessions


We hope these bugfixes improve your experience with the game. 

[h1]Last but not least, looK INside - Chapter 2 now comes out on September, 19th 2022[/h1]

Make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725360/looK_INside__Chapter_2/]wishlist[/url] the game if you don't want to miss its release ! 

Have a wonderful day, 

Lauriane, Ambre and Audrey.

notes.title: Big Update Patch Note and Announcement!
notes.notes:
We got some money to get back to work on looK INside. We immediately took the opportunity to use all your feedback and make the version of Chapter I that we would have liked to release from the start!

We hope you will enjoy this new version, here is the patch note:

[h1]looK INside - Chapter 1 entirely updated [/h1]

[h2]Fixed all minor bugs reported by players since release[/h2]
[list]
[*][Tree] Alice's first name could be obtained in duplicate at the end of chap. 1
[*][Tree] Manon's portrait did not appear larger when you clicked on the eye.
[*][Graphics] Some UI images were stretched
[*][UX] Clicking too fast abruptly caused a “bonus” text to appear
[*][Graphics] The link between the letters KAYAK was made out of scope
[*][Localization] Raph’s letter highlighting did not work when changing languages
[*][Load] The bowl on Raphael's desk was not empty when we finished the kayaking mini-game
[*]Fixes of other minor bugs
[/list]

[h2]Correction on UX based on your feedback[/h2]
[list]
[*][UX] completely remove the magnet from the library
[*][UX] creation of outlines and links between objects so that some puzzle are less tricky
[*][Steam] Phone Success Update "A Call From The Past"
[*]Addition of a completion indication for each page in the summary as requested by the players
[/list]

[h2]Other improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added two free interaction mini-games to the computer on Raphael's page
[*]Multiple corrections in the English and Spanish translations and addition of drawings and pictograms to make certain mini-games more understandable.
[*]Additional QA to find and fix other bugs
[*]Translation of all achievements in English
[*]Added Steam DRM (sorry but hacked versions were just too numerous)
[/list]

[h1]Announcement [/h1]

You can imagine that we did not receive a new budget just for the improvement of looK INside Chapter I, we will soon have some very good news to tell you for the future. We will keep you informed very quickly;)
